Marty’s Cracklin’ &

Main Menu

Chips

Other chips that I loved growing up (that were also often
hid from me) were Marty’s Cracklin’ and Baconette Strips.
They’re
made
by
the
same
company,
so
you
may
find
some similarities in their texture.

Baconette
Strips
doesn’t
really
taste
anything
close
to
bacon
in
my
opinion,
but
my
mouth
still
waters
over
its
savory crunch and tempting smell. It’s one of my biggest
recurring favorites of all time — I hope you’ll get an idea
of the food I enjoy the most from this snack.

Marty’s
Cracklin’
is
more
known
for
its
salt-and-vinegar
variant.
Filipinos
love
their
spices.
I
got
you
the
plain
salted
one, as I wanted you to try out the plainer flavors before you
get here. Think of it as a way for you to ease into our cuisine
:3. Still a very goated flavor, though. I actually prefer it over

the salt-and-vinegar one. :P
